name: @pithy-sh/monorepo

scripts.reset: turbo run reset && rm -rf node_modules && bun install
scripts.version: changeset version && bun scripts/stampVersions.ts && bun install --lockfile-only

reactOverrideComment: react and react-dom MUST resolve to the exact same version, or React refuses to run at all:
`Incompatible React versions: the "react" and "react-dom" packages must have the exact same version`.
Nothing in this workspace declared react until @pithy-sh/cli took a dependency on it for `pithy dev`'s
live roster (ink needs it, #670). That one `bun add` re-resolved react to 19.3.0 while react-dom stayed
at the locked 19.2.8 — and the failure did not land in the CLI. It landed in the project
`packages/cli/src/project/scaffoldGates.test.ts` scaffolds, whose seeded `.tsx` gates mount a real
front end and resolve both packages. A CLI dependency broke an adopter's front end.
So the pair is pinned together, and pinned symmetrically so the reverse drift is impossible too.
The declared ranges stay `^19.2.8` — adopters are not affected, and this is a workspace install
BUMP BOTH LINES AT ONCE, never one: run `bun run --filter @pithy-sh/cli test` afterwards, which is
where the scaffolded front end's gates run.
